study_type_evidence.quote: BALB/c mice (8 weeks old) were purchased from the Beijing Vital River Laboratory Animal Technology Co., Ltd.
Each group had 11 3-day-old newborn mice. To evaluate the prophylactic and therapeutic effect of FL-EK1 on HCoV-OC43-infected mice
Anti-SARS-CoV-2 PsV activity of mouse serum samples was determined in the same way as that described above.
The cytotoxicity of FL-EK1 to Huh7, Caco2, RD, and Calu3 cells was measured by using the CCK8 kit

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: female BALB/c, 8 weeks old (pharmacokinetics and safety)
in_vivo_species.quote: 100 μL of FL-EK1 and EK1 (380 μM) were intraperitoneally injected into three female BALB/c mice.

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: ICR newborn mice, 3 days old (sex not reported)
8-week-old SPF Tgtn (CAG-humanACE2-IRES-Luciferase) transgenic mice (sex not reported)
in_vivo_species.quote: Eight-week-old SPF Tgtn (CAG-humanACE2-IRES-Luciferase) mice purchased from Shanghai Model Organisms Center, Inc.

ex_vivo_detail: Mouse serum collected at serial time points after intraperitoneal FL-EK1 or EK1 was assayed ex vivo for inhibition of pseudotyped SARS-CoV-2 infection; serum dilution causing 50% inhibition was used to estimate serum peptide concentration. Classified ex vivo per protocol because the serum was removed from the animal and then treated.
in_vitro_detail: Cell-culture assays: pseudotyped and authentic HCoV infection inhibition in 293T, Caco2, Calu3, RD and Huh-7 cells; S protein-mediated cell-cell fusion assay; CCK8 cytotoxicity. Cell-free assays: N-PAGE 6-HB formation between HR1P and HR2P peptides; isothermal titration calorimetry of FL-EK1 binding to human serum albumin.

concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: (B) Concentration of FL-EK1 and EK1 in mouse serum samples and the half-life of each were estimated.
concentration_time_figure.note: Fig. 6B plots estimated serum concentration of FL-EK1 and EK1 against time after intraperitoneal injection. Fig. 6A plots ex vivo anti-SARS-CoV-2 pseudovirus activity (fold of IC50) of the same serum samples against time (n = 3).

bioanalytical_method: Ex vivo pseudotyped SARS-CoV-2 neutralization bioassay: serum concentrations were estimated from the highest serum dilution giving 50% inhibition of pseudovirus infection, then fitted by non-compartmental analysis in MODFIT software
bioanalytical_quote: we estimated the concentrations of FL-EK1 and EK1 in sera collected at different time points based on the serum dilutions of FL-EK1 and EK1 for in vitro inhibition
notes: Peptide concentrations were not measured directly by an immunoassay or mass spectrometry in this study; they were back-calculated from ex vivo pseudovirus neutralization potency and fitted with MODFIT (NCA). Sandwich ELISA is mentioned only as the method used in the authors' PREVIOUS study on CP24/IBP-CP24 in rhesus monkey sera, not here. Dose is inconsistent between sections: Methods 2.10 states 100 μL of 380 μM for both peptides, while Results 3.5 states 40 mg/kg FL-EK1 and 8.25 mg/kg EK1; both recorded. Safety study used a different dose (30 mg/kg i.p.) and Results 3.6 describes the safety dosing as intranasal, which conflicts with Methods 2.11 (intraperitoneal). No amino acid sequences are printed anywhere in the body or figure captions, so all sequences are 'not reported' even though Fig. 1A is said to display them. Table 2 labels the parameter 'T1/2' without naming a kinetic phase, so half_life_phase is 'unspecified'.
